verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing one-time passwords and viewing them on another device (Apple Watch). Community users report it working across desktop and mobile apps and on many devices, which implies the same account is reachable everywhere. However, no evidence explicitly documents automatic real-time sync of tokens across phone, tablet and computer. missing for 10: first-party documentation of automatic cross-device sync, explicit tablet/phone/computer simultaneous availability, independent hands-on verification of OTP sync.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords
